name: Prospeo
description: Email & mobile finder — enrich a person to a verified work email and direct phone.

methods.label: Enrich Person
methods.description: Find a verified work email (and optional mobile) for a person. Put the identifiers inside `data`: either { linkedin_url } OR { email } OR { full_name, company } OR { first_name, last_name, company_name | company_website | company_linkedin_url }. Returns { person: { email: { status, revealed, email }, mobile } }. Set enrich_mobile to also reveal a phone (extra cost).

only_verified_email.description: Only return the email if it is verified

enrich_mobile.description: Also attempt to reveal a direct mobile number

methods.label: Account Information
methods.description: Get remaining credits and account details. Returns { response: { remaining_credits, ... } }.
